topPRs.title: FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate: add optional L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Adds an opt-in L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check to `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate`, gated on a new optional `l2RpcUrls` TOML field
- Catches the failure mode where the L1 Safe tx executes successfully but the L2 `upgradeAndCall` deposits silently revert with `onlyOwner` because the L2 ProxyAdmin isn't owned by the aliased L1 PAO
- Backward compatible: when `l2RpcUrls` is absent, a warning is printed and the check is skipped — existing tasks and the 034 arena-z regression fixture run unchanged

## Motivation

While verifying [085-migrations-sop-1-fee-vault-update](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/sep/085-migrations-sop-1-fee-vault-update) we found that the L1 task tx (https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x4e92b55e0e944ac89743f7562393a929d8efd82dfdb94972ac5a43b02b9edd12) succeeded and emitted all 7 expected `TransactionDeposited` events, but the 4 `upgradeAndCall` deposits all reverted on L2 (status `0x0`, identical 30,605 gas — classic `onlyOwner` revert), leaving the fee vaults at their original impls/recipients.

Root cause: the `migrations-sop` devnet family was bootstrapped with a plain L2 EOA as `L2ProxyAdmin.owner()` rather than the canonical `aliased(L1_PAO)`, so deposits arriving with `from = aliased(rootSafe)` are rejected.

On any canonical OP Stack chain the template already works correctly. This check is a safety net for misconfigured chains (devnets, mis-bootstrapped tenants) — operators get a clear simulation-time error instead of discovering the silent revert after signing.

## Usage

Add to `config.toml`:

```toml
l2RpcUrls = [
  "https://migrations-sop-1.optimism.io",  # URL...
  "opSepolia",                              # ...or foundry.toml rpc alias
]
```

Length must equal `l2chains.length` and order must match.

When the check fails, the revert message points operators at [`TransferL2PAOFromL1`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/blob/main/src/template/TransferL2PAOFromL1.sol) as the fix.

## Test plan

- [x] `forge build` — compiles
- [x] `forge test --match-test testRegressionCallDataMatches_FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate` — passes (existing 034 fixture has no `l2RpcUrls`, hits the warn-and-skip path; calldata unchanged)
- [ ] Manual: run a sim with `l2RpcUrls` pointing at a chain where L2 PA is correctly owned by aliased L1 PAO → check passes silently
- [ ] Manual: run a sim with `l2RpcUrls` pointing at `migrations-sop-1` → check reverts with the expected diagnostic

topPRs.title: 084: update prestate to op-program/v1.9.0-rc.1 Cannon64 (multichain build)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Updates both FDG (game type 0) and PDG (game type 1) `gameArgs` in `src/tasks/sep/084-migrations-sop-1-proposer-rotation/` to embed the freshly-built `op-program/v1.9.0-rc.1` Cannon64 absolute prestate `0x032ab5ac33a98dc99947c54eeb0bf84f22abe4be0b01537235218164492ecab9`.
- The prestate was rebuilt locally with **both** `migrations-sop-0` (420120109) and `migrations-sop-1` (420120110) chain configs placed in `op-program/chainconfig/configs/` (`<chain-id>-rollup.json` + `<chain-id>-genesis-l2.json` for each). Preimage uploaded to `gs://oplabs-network-data/proofs/op-program/cannon/0x032ab5ac…ecab9.bin.gz`.
- Effective on-chain change vs. the previous draft of 084:
  - **FDG (game type 0):** now emits a `setImplementation` call (the template's skip-if-unchanged guard in `SetDisputeGameImpl._setFDGImplementation` no longer fires now that `fdgGameArgs` differs from on-chain). Only the prestate bytes change; impl / vm / ASR / weth / chainId are unchanged.
  - **PDG (game type 1):** prestate bytes change (was `0x0355d19a…`, now `0x032ab5ac…`); proposer + challenger rotation is unchanged from the previous draft.
- `Domain Hash`, `Message Hash`, `Safe Hash`, EIP-712 digest, and the task calldata in `VALIDATION.md` were regenerated via `just simulate` at latest block (PAO Safe nonce override = 105, unchanged).

## Files changed

- `src/tasks/sep/084-migrations-sop-1-proposer-rotation/config.toml` — new `fdgGameArgs` and `pdgGameArgs` hex; comments rewritten to reflect the expanded scope.
- `src/tasks/sep/084-migrations-sop-1-proposer-rotation/README.md` — objective + state-changes section now covers both game types (separate FDG and PDG tables).
- `src/tasks/sep/084-migrations-sop-1-proposer-rotation/VALIDATION.md` — Domain / Message / Safe hashes, calldata blob, and EIP-712 digest re-pasted from a fresh `just simulate`. Expected-output section now decomposes both sub-calls.

## Test plan

- [ ] Reviewer re-runs `SIMULATE_WITHOUT_LEDGER=1 just --dotenv-path \$(pwd)/.env --justfile ../../../justfile simulate` from `src/tasks/sep/084-migrations-sop-1-proposer-rotation` and confirms:
  - Safe Hash matches `0x0f383beadc983ca38c120505ef9d7d0b9735d231c5d975b6f3ecd3cbae895197`
  - Domain Hash matches `0x07e03428d7125835eca12b6dd1a02903029b456da3a091ecd66fda859fbce61e`
  - Message Hash matches `0xf4d026a2fb539bcf480ef9eeaed288eeef6acde188a12fca7be12d389b47b9f9`
- [ ] Tenderly state-change diff shows the expected slot writes on `0xD22e520F…23` (DisputeGameFactoryProxy):
  - gameArgs(0) prestate slot `0x2e713cda…2ea5`: `0x038c5780…ec6c` → `0x032ab5ac…ecab9`
  - gameArgs(1) prestate slot `0x9afb513d…fa7c`: `0x038512e0…d54c` → `0x032ab5ac…ecab9`
  - gameArgs(1) proposer/challenger composite slots (`…fa7f` / `…fa80` / `…fa81`) match the rotation already in the previous draft.
- [ ] PAO Safe nonce slot `0x…05`: `105` → `106`.

topPRs.title: Mark U19 betanet tasks 076-079 as EXECUTED on Sepolia
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:

- Tasks ran in order against the shared PAO Safe `0xe934Dc97E347C6aCef74364B50125bb8689c40ff`; nonces 96 → 97 → 98 → 99 consumed as planned.

|---|---|---|
| 076 — U19 on u19-beta-0 (permissioned) | [`0x22443867…dabe6`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x224438675d623a5e21a3801d0bf238a8fbf7a1f3de1091041b234ab3eacdabe6) | 10936541 |
| 077 — Wire CANNON impl on u19-beta-1 | [`0x1ef77215…e03a8`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x1ef77215da763cb3da09601451714ab6d1b0727fe2491b9f606b53730e9e03a8) | 10936564 |
| 078 — Flip respectedGameType to CANNON on u19-beta-1 | [`0x93a13e48…a066d`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x93a13e48eaf8b37da09a5477483e8bf6581f8a5980af6936daff8a1e80ca066d) | 10936575 |
| 079 — U19 on u19-beta-1 (permissionless) | [`0x1b64de87…cb070`](https://sepolia.etherscan.io/tx/0x1b64de8763564ed35003db4b8cbd651936b884e2c608b3614da6ed67642cb070) | 10936594 |

## Test plan
- [x] Confirmed each tx is on Sepolia, `from = 0x1077…4fcd`, `to = PAO Safe 0xe934…40ff`
- [x] Confirmed sequential block ordering (10936541 → 564 → 575 → 594)
- [ ] Optional: verify each tx receipt has `status: 1` and the expected post-state on a Sepolia explorer
